prompt: Trong mặt phẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, đường tròn <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> có tâm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>I</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> tiếp xúc với đường thẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>Δ</mi><mo>:</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>. Hỏi bán kính đường tròn <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> bằng bao nhiêu?
solution: Bán kính của <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math> là <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>I</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Δ</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">|</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">|</mo></mrow><msqrt><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>25</mn></mrow></msqrt></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mn>14</mn><msqrt><mn>26</mn></msqrt></mfrac></mrow></semantics></math>.
